page.layout: One page: a ruled table of years in the centre (left column of years, right column of "Iidem sex." entries), with printed marginal notes in the right margin beside the rows for 1378, 1380, 1381 and 1382. Page number at the top centre.

main_text.l: 1378 | Iidem sex. Fœdus defensivum civitatis cum Hunesgonii & Hummerciis.
1380 | Iidem sex. Privilegiû civitati confirmatû ab episc. V ltr. Floretio in casib episc. de non evocâdo ultra Holsvordæ[?].
1381 | Iidem sex. Cum Groning. Ostergoi & VVestergoi, ac reliqui eius vicinię fœdus inierunt pro defendenda libertate.
1382 | Iidem sex. Eidem fœderi accesserc[?] Hunesgonii & Fivelgonii.

page.notes: The ruled horizontal lines between the rows are typographic rules, not text. The vertical rules are the table frame. The marginal note beside 1380 begins between the 1379 and 1380 rows; it is attached to 1380 because it runs mostly alongside that row. "Holsvordæ" is uncertain in the scan (the long s is hard to separate from f), so it is marked [?]. "accesserc" is uncertain at the line end and is marked [?]; it may be "accesserunt". The § at the foot stands alone under the table and is copied as printed. The page carries no running head, catchword or signature.
